venues.name: House Stark
venues.description: The ancient seat of the Kings in the North, a granite fortress warmed by hot springs beneath its walls. Its motto, 'Winter is Coming', greets every guest who braves the long road north.

venues.name: House Targaryen
venues.description: A brooding island citadel of carved dragons and black stone, once home to the last dragonlords of Valyria. 'Fire and Blood' is served here, under the shadow of the Dragonmont.

venues.name: House Lannister
venues.description: A colossal stronghold hewn from a mountain above Lannisport, rich with gold and pride. As they say, a Lannister always pays his debts — 'Hear Me Roar!'

venues.name: The Night's Watch
venues.address: Castle Black, The Wall, The North
venues.description: The black brotherhood that guards the realms of men from atop a seven-hundred-foot wall of ice. Those who take the black swear to hold no lands and win no glory — 'And now my watch begins.'
